Press Release · Please find enclosed the Press Release on the performance of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.

Updates · The Board of Directors at their meeting held today i.e., 29th October 2026, has, inter alia, approved the payment of interim dividend of Rs. 5.75 (Rupees five and paise seventy-five only) per equity share of the face value of Re. 1 each for the financial year ending 31st March 2027

Outcome of Board Meeting · The Board of Directors at its meeting held today i.e., 29th October 2026, has, inter alia, approved the audited standalone and unaudited consolidated financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 and payment of interim dividend of Rs. 5.75 (Rupees five and paise seventy-five only) per equity share of the face value of Re. 1 each for the financial year ending 31st March 2027

Dividend · The Board of Directors at its meeting held today i.e., 29th October 2026, has, inter alia, approved the audited standalone and unaudited consolidated financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 and payment of interim dividend of Rs. 5.75 (Rupees five and paise seventy-five only) per equity share of the face value of Re. 1 each for the financial year ending 31st March 2027.
Outcome of Board Meeting · Asian Paints Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Copy of Newspaper Publication · Please find enclosed newspaper advertisement published on 8th October 2026 informing about the resolution proposed to be passed through Postal Ballot and details relating to e-Voting facility.

Shareholders meeting · Please find enclosed the Postal Ballot Notice dated 7th September 2026 together with the Explanatory Statement being sent to the members of the Company seeking their approval for appointment of Mr. Leo Puri as an Independent Director of the Company for a term of five consecutive years commencing from 7th September 2026 to 6th September 2031.

Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates · The Company will hold a conference with investors on 29th October 2026 at 5 p.m. IST.on the business and financial performance of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.
Record Date · Asian Paints Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 04-Nov-2026.

Updates · Asian Paints Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'This is to inform you that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held on Thursday, 29th October 2026, inter alia, to consider the declaration of interim dividend, if any, for the financial year ending 31st March 2027.  It is further informed that the record date for payment of interim dividend, if declared, will be Wednesday, 4th November 2026.'.
